source.title: Cavite Ecological Profile 2024
source.provider: Provincial Government of Cavite; source table credited to the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist, Trece Martires City
source.table: Table 4.25, page 209: Commonly Caught Fist Species in Municipal Fisheries, Province of Cavite: 2024 (the table heading contains this apparent typo)
source.accessStatus: Official provincial PDF; relevant search-indexed table and source attribution reviewed. PDF is 26.7 MB and the web page viewer rejected direct extraction due to content size.
source.reuseStatus: No item-specific reuse license was verified. Retain attribution and research-only summaries; do not reproduce the table wholesale or publish derived app content until reuse terms are reviewed.

sourceNamedFishingGrounds: adjacent waters near Batangas, Mindoro, and Bataan
scope.siteAttribution: The profile names these as province-level fishing grounds, but Table 4.25 does not assign individual catch labels or seasons to any one ground, landing site, municipality, or waterbody.
scope.unit: month names/periods; no catch quantities are provided in Table 4.25
scope.taxonomicResolution: Source-reported common names only; no scientific names, taxonomic authorities, vouchers, or species-level diagnostic evidence are supplied.

decision.use: Keep the eleven labels as province-level leads for targeted taxonomic and locality-resolved research; the seasonal fields are source-reported fishery context only.

limitations: The profile is not a fish survey or an exhaustive Cavite species inventory.
Do not assign any row to Manila Bay, Bacoor Bay, Cañacao Bay, a river, lake, municipality, or landing center without row-level evidence.
Common labels can be ambiguous or represent multiple taxa; do not infer a binomial from the label alone.
Source years, season labels, and peak/lean periods describe this report's municipal-fisheries context, not a forecast or current catch recommendation.
Do not use this source alone for diet, bait advice, legal status, conservation status, safety, abundance, or map geometry.
nextStep: Seek locality- and taxon-resolved primary fisheries surveys or voucher records for Cavite's coastal waters. Keep these province-wide names and season labels separate from inland river/lake evidence and from public species assertions.
